effects.description: [On Play] Play up to 1 [Monster] from your hand.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
You have at least 1 card named [Monster] in your hand
steps: Play the chosen [Monster] card onto your field
If you do, you don't have to pay the cost
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You don't have to play a [Monster] card if you don't want to

effects.description: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] This Character gains +2000 power during this turn.
conditions: This Character has 1 DON!! card attached
steps: When this Character attacks, give it +2000 power for this turn
notes: You don't need to activate this manually — it happens automatically when this Character attacks with 1 DON!! attached
The power bonus lasts only until the end of this turn
